findings.evidence: `mathlib/Mathlib/RingTheory/LinearDisjoint.lean:778` provides `of_linearDisjoint_finite_left` for an integral left algebra. Finite subalgebras are fields by `isField_of_isIntegral_of_isField'`; `Subalgebra.toIntermediateField'` (IntermediateField/Basic.lean:285) and `IntermediateField.map_comap_eq_self` (Adjoin/Defs.lean:713) provide the conversions.
findings.fix: Use `Subalgebra.LinearDisjoint.of_linearDisjoint_finite_left` on the image subalgebra. Convert each finite subalgebra to an intermediate field, pull it back along the constants embedding, and apply `h`; retain only this interface conversion.
